# Feeling Good Institute

> Evidence-based CBT therapy platform offering TEAM-CBT services, therapist certification training, and mental health treatment through certified practitioners and online sessions.

Feeling Good Institute is dedicated to providing effective, evidence-based cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and TEAM-CBT methods developed by Dr. David Burns. The institute offers both direct mental health services to clients and comprehensive training and certification programs for mental health clinicians seeking to advance their therapeutic skills.

## Getting Started & Finding Help

- [Feeling Good Institute | Effective Evidence-Based Therapy](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com): Homepage introducing Feeling Good Institute's evidence-based therapy methods including CBT, DBT, EMDR, and ACT.
- [About Us | Feeling Good Institute | TEAM-CBT Therapy](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com/about-us): About Feeling Good Institute's mission, TEAM-CBT approach, and Dr. David Burns' work.
- [Our Approach to Therapy - Proven CBT Methods That Works](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com/our-approach): Explanation of TEAM-CBT therapeutic approach and empathetic CBT methods by Dr. David Burns.
- [Treat Your Mental Health Issues | Feeling Good Institute](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com/how-we-help): Overview of mental health services including CBT therapy, therapist matching, and consultations.

## Mental Health Services

- [Find the Best Therapist For You | Feeling Good Institute](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com/find-cbt-therapist/get-matched): Therapist matching tool to find certified CBT therapists suited to individual needs.
- [Find TEAM-CBT Certified Therapists and Trainers Near You](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com/find-cbt-therapist): Find TEAM-CBT certified therapists including Angela Krumm, Jill Levitt, and Kevin Cornelius.
- [Find Certified Therapists Near You | TEAM-CBT Directory](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com/cbt-therapists-directory): TEAM-CBT certified therapist directory to find mental health providers near you.
- [Online Therapy | Book a Session with Expert Therapists](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com/how-we-help/online-cbt-therapy): Online CBT therapy services offering HIPAA-compliant video counseling with certified therapists.
- [What is Intensive Therapy - Intensive Program for Individuals](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com/how-we-help/intensive-cbt-therapy): Intensive CBT therapy program for accelerated healing available in USA and Canada.
- [Feeling Good Institute | CBT Therapist Near Me | Lower Fee Option](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com/lower-fee-options): Affordable TEAM-CBT therapy options through Feeling Good Foundation with supervised therapists.

## Clinician Training & Certification

- [TEAM-CBT Training and Certification for Clinicians](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com/for-clinicians): TEAM-CBT training, supervision, and certification programs for mental health professionals.
- [Become a Certified CBT Therapist | Online Certification](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com/for-cbt-therapists/certification): TEAM-CBT certification program with five levels for therapist credential advancement.
- [Level 3 TEAM-CBT Certification Fast Track Course](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com/for-clinicians/fast-track-to-level-3-team-cbt-certification): 25-week fast-track course to Level 3 TEAM-CBT certification with 46 continuing education credits.
- [CBT All Access: TEAM-CBT Learning, Training & CEs](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com/for-clinicians/cbt-all-access): CBT All Access subscription offering unlimited TEAM-CBT training, practice groups, and CEs.
- [CE Courses and Consultation Groups](https://feelinggoodinstitute.com/for-cbt-therapists/speciality-consultation-group): Expert-led consultation groups with David Burns and Jill Levitt for advanced CBT techniques.

## Organization & Team Training
